item.description: This week the White House announced more than 200 new signatories for the Ratepayer Protection Pledge, aimed at lowering utility costs Americans may face during data center building and development.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Outbreak of diarrhea-causing parasite linked to 4 more states
item.description: Federal health officials on Friday said they have linked cases of a diarrhea-causing parasite tied to shredded lettuce to an additional four states.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Paramount agrees to delay closing its Warner Bros buyout for months
item.description: Skydance-owned Paramount on Friday agreed to delay closing its $81 billion buyout of Warner Bros. Discovery well into next year, as a judge continues to consider a challenge from 12 states seeking to block the deal altogether.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pentagon says website issue caused discrepancy in Iran conflict death toll
item.description: The Pentagon is facing new questions about how it reports casualties from the conflict with Iran following the deaths of four U.S. service members this month.
